note.ja: 12手法のうちLangevinとCSVRの2手法に専用実装。旧1自由度Langevin/BAOABの調和例を保持し、別版の同じOBABO分割で、非縮退2自由度の調和系とquartic係数λ=0.2の2自由度非調和系を比較します。CSVR単独の運動エネルギー核も検査。他の10手法は実装予定です。
note.en: Two of the 12 methods have dedicated implementations: Langevin and CSVR. Preserve the earlier one-degree-of-freedom harmonic Langevin/BAOAB case. A separate edition compares both baths with the same OBABO splitting for a nondegenerate two-degree harmonic system and a two-degree anharmonic system with quartic coefficient lambda=0.2, and checks the standalone CSVR kinetic-energy kernel. The other 10 methods remain planned.
